name: Greek yogurt berry bowl
method: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl and top with blueberries, oats and chia seeds.

name: Protein overnight oats
method: Stir oats, skyr, milk and protein powder together in a jar and chill overnight. Top with raspberries in the morning.

name: Spinach and feta egg-white omelette
method: Wilt the spinach in a little oil, pour over the whisked egg whites and egg, scatter with feta and fold. Serve with a slice of toast.

name: Smoked salmon scrambled eggs on rye
method: Scramble the eggs and egg whites gently in butter, fold in torn smoked salmon and pile onto toasted rye.

name: Cottage cheese oat pancakes
method: Blend oats, eggs, cottage cheese and banana into a batter and cook small pancakes in a non-stick pan. Serve with sliced strawberries.

name: Turmeric tofu scramble on toast
method: Crumble the tofu into a hot pan with oil, turmeric and nutritional yeast, add halved tomatoes and spinach and cook until wilted. Serve on toast.

name: Shakshuka with feta
method: Soften onion and pepper in oil, add tomatoes, cumin and paprika and simmer 5 minutes. Make wells, crack in the eggs and whites, cover until just set and crumble over feta.

name: Skyr with banana and peanut butter
method: Spoon the skyr into a bowl, slice over the banana and drizzle with warmed peanut butter.

name: Berry and oat protein smoothie
method: Blend everything until smooth, adding a splash of water if it is too thick.

name: Green banana protein smoothie
method: Blend the soy milk, banana, spinach, protein powder and chia seeds until completely smooth.

name: Cottage cheese and tomato toast
method: Toast the bread, spread thickly with cottage cheese and top with halved tomatoes, pumpkin seeds, black pepper and a pinch of salt.

name: Savoury parmesan oats with a fried egg
method: Simmer the oats in water, stir in the egg whites and spinach until thick and creamy, then top with a fried egg, parmesan and spring onion.

name: Apple and cinnamon protein porridge
method: Cook the oats in soy milk with grated apple and cinnamon, stir in the protein powder off the heat and scatter with walnuts.

name: Chicken and quinoa power bowl
method: Pile warm quinoa into a bowl with sliced chicken, avocado, tomatoes and cucumber. Squeeze over lemon and season well.

name: Tuna and white bean salad
method: Toss drained tuna and beans with finely sliced onion, halved tomatoes and rocket. Dress with olive oil, lemon and black pepper.

name: Red lentil dal with brown rice
method: Simmer red lentils with turmeric, then finish with a tempering of cumin, garlic and chilli fried in a little oil. Stir in spinach and serve over rice.

name: Chicken shawarma salad plate
method: Pan-fry sliced chicken with shawarma spices until charred. Serve with chopped salad, a spoon of hummus and warm pitta.

name: Bibimbap-style tofu bowl
method: Pan-fry cubed tofu in sesame oil until crisp. Arrange over rice with kimchi, spinach, grated carrot and sprouts, add gochujang and sesame seeds and mix.

name: Prawn, avocado and edamame rice bowl
method: Arrange prawns, avocado, cucumber and edamame over warm rice. Mix soy sauce and lime juice and drizzle over.

name: Turkey and hummus wrap
method: Spread hummus over the wrap, layer with turkey, leaves, pepper and tomato, then roll up. Eat with an apple on the side.

name: Chickpea pasta pesto salad
method: Toss the cooked chickpea pasta with pesto while warm, then fold in tomatoes, spinach and mozzarella.

name: Egg salad open sandwich on rye
method: Chop the boiled eggs and mix with yogurt, mustard and spring onion. Pile onto rye bread and top with cucumber slices.

name: Miso salmon soba bowl
method: Brush salmon with miso and bake for 12 minutes. Serve over soba noodles with stir-fried bok choy, edamame and spring onion.

name: Chicken tikka salad pitta
method: Grill the marinated chicken tikka pieces until charred. Stuff into a warm pitta with salad, sliced onion and raita.

name: Chicken and black bean burrito bowl
method: Layer rice, warmed black beans and sliced chicken in a bowl. Top with salsa, shredded lettuce, a spoon of yogurt and a squeeze of lime.

name: Warm lentil and halloumi salad
method: Griddle the halloumi slices until golden. Toss warm lentils with peppers, tomatoes, rocket and balsamic, then top with the halloumi.

name: Tempeh satay noodle salad
method: Pan-fry sliced tempeh until crisp. Toss with noodles, shredded carrot, cabbage and edamame, then dress with satay sauce loosened with lime juice.

name: Tom yum prawn noodle soup
method: Bring the tom yum broth to a simmer with sliced mushrooms, add the extra prawns and noodles and heat through for 2 minutes.

name: Tuna and cottage cheese jacket potato
method: Microwave the potato until soft and split open. Mix tuna, cottage cheese, sweetcorn and spring onion and pile on top.

name: Chicken larb lettuce cups
method: Fry minced chicken with lime, fish sauce, chilli, shallot and toasted rice powder. Spoon into lettuce leaves with cucumber and a little rice.

name: Ginger chicken and vegetable stir-fry
method: Stir-fry sliced chicken in sesame oil with garlic and ginger, add the vegetables and soy sauce and toss for 3 minutes. Serve with jasmine rice.

name: Salmon and sweet potato traybake
method: Roast sweet potato chunks in oil for 20 minutes, add the salmon and broccoli and roast 10 more. Finish with lemon juice.

name: Turkey and kidney bean chilli
method: Brown the turkey with onion and pepper, add tomatoes, beans, cumin, smoked paprika and chilli and simmer 20 minutes. Serve with brown rice.

name: Lean beef bolognese with lentil pasta
method: Brown the mince with onion and garlic, stir in the tomato sauce and simmer 15 minutes. Toss with red lentil pasta and grate over parmesan.

name: Tofu, coconut and spinach curry
method: Fry cubed tofu until golden, add ginger, garlic and curry powder, then tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in spinach and serve with rice.

name: Garlic prawn and courgette pasta
method: Fry garlic, chilli and ribboned courgette in oil, add tomatoes and prawns for 2 minutes, then toss with the pasta and lemon juice.

name: Chicken and black bean tacos
method: Toss shredded chicken with cumin, paprika and lime. Warm the corn tortillas and fill with chicken, black beans, lettuce, pico de gallo and avocado.

name: Lemon baked cod with crushed potatoes and peas
method: Bake the cod with lemon and capers for 15 minutes. Crush the boiled potatoes with olive oil and serve with peas and wilted spinach.

name: Beef bulgogi rice bowl
method: Marinate thin beef strips in soy, garlic, pear and sesame, then sear hard in a hot pan. Serve over rice with kimchi, spinach and a fried egg.

name: Seitan teriyaki udon stir-fry
method: Fry sliced seitan in sesame oil until browned, add the vegetables and udon, pour over teriyaki sauce and toss until glossy.

name: Baked eggs with chickpeas and roasted vegetables
method: Roast the vegetables with the chickpeas and paprika for 20 minutes, crack the eggs on top, scatter with feta and bake until the whites set.

name: Shish taouk with bulgur and chopped salad
method: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon, garlic and paprika, thread onto skewers and grill. Serve with bulgur, chopped salad and tzatziki.

name: Blackened tilapia with mango salsa and quinoa
method: Rub the tilapia with Cajun spices and pan-fry 3 minutes a side. Mix diced mango into the pico de gallo and serve over quinoa with avocado.

name: Lentil bolognese with red lentil pasta
method: Simmer lentils with onion, carrot, garlic and tomatoes until thick. Toss with the pasta and spinach and sprinkle with nutritional yeast.

name: Chicken and chickpea tagine
method: Brown the chicken with onion, stir in harissa, tomatoes, chickpeas and olives and simmer 25 minutes. Serve with wholewheat couscous.

name: Turkey meatballs in tomato sauce with spaghetti
method: Roll seasoned turkey mince into meatballs, brown them, then simmer in the tomato sauce with garlic for 15 minutes. Serve over spaghetti with parmesan.

name: Miso tofu noodle soup
method: Whisk miso into hot water, add cubed tofu, edamame and bok choy and simmer 5 minutes. Pour over soba noodles and top with spring onion and nori.

name: Sirloin steak with chimichurri and roasted vegetables
method: Roast the vegetables for 20 minutes. Sear the steak 3 minutes a side, rest, slice and spoon over chimichurri.

name: Paneer tikka with saag and chapati
method: Marinate paneer in yogurt and tikka spices and grill until charred. Serve with spiced greens, a warm chapati and raita.

name: Smoky black bean and sweet potato chilli
method: Soften onion and pepper in oil, add soya mince, tomatoes, beans, sweet potato chunks and smoked paprika and simmer 25 minutes until thick.

name: Cottage cheese with pineapple
method: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl and top with pineapple chunks.

name: Boiled eggs with cherry tomatoes
method: Halve two boiled eggs, season with salt and pepper and eat with cherry tomatoes.

name: Chilli lime edamame
method: Steam the edamame for 3 minutes, then toss with lime juice, chopped chilli and flaky salt.

name: Greek yogurt with honey and walnuts
method: Drizzle the honey over the yogurt and scatter with crushed walnuts.

name: Turkey and cheese roll-ups
method: Lay a slice of cheese and a gherkin on each turkey slice and roll up.

name: Banana protein shake
method: Blend the milk, banana and protein powder with a few ice cubes until smooth.

name: Hummus and lupini bean veg plate
method: Arrange the lupini beans, cucumber sticks and baby carrots around a spoonful of hummus for dipping.

name: Roasted chickpea and seed mix
method: Mix the roasted chickpeas, pumpkin seeds and soy nuts in a small pot; make a batch and portion for the week.

name: Smoked salmon rice cakes
method: Spread the rice cakes with light cream cheese and top with smoked salmon, cucumber and black pepper.

name: Tuna cucumber boats
method: Halve the cucumber lengthways and scoop out the seeds. Mix tuna with yogurt and mustard and spoon into the hollows.

name: Skyr berry chia pot
method: Stir the chia seeds into the skyr and top with thawed berries.

name: Cheddar, oatcakes and apple
method: Top the oatcakes with slices of cheddar and eat with apple wedges.

name: Miso soup with extra tofu
method: Heat the miso soup and add extra cubed tofu, warming through for 2 minutes.

name: Biltong and clementine
method: Pair a small handful of biltong with a peeled clementine.

name: Dark chocolate protein yogurt
method: Whisk the protein powder into the yogurt until smooth and grate over the dark chocolate.

name: Veggie egg muffins
method: Whisk eggs and whites with chopped spinach, pepper and cheese, pour into two muffin cups and bake at 180C for 18 minutes. Makes a batch to keep in the fridge.
